newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Lee & Man says IPO 25 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Lee & Man says IPO 25 times subscribed.

text.p: Lee & Man Holdings Ltd said on Monday its offering of 185.625 million shares to the public in Hong Kong was 25 times subscribed.
Lee & Man offered a total 206.25 million shares, comprising 165 million new shares and 41.25 million existing shares, at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO).
The handbags and paper products maker said it received applications for 4.68 billion shares compared with the 185.625 million shares available for public subscription.
Another 20.625 million shares offered on a preferential basis to employee were fully alloted.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on May 28.
Lee & Man makes paper packaging products such as corrugated cardboard and packaging boxes. It also manufactures and exports handbags, soft luggage and audio cassettes.
